import sys

def _truncate_utf8(data, limit):
    if limit <= 0:
        return b'', len(data) > 0
    if len(data) <= limit:
        return data, False
    truncated = data[:limit]
    # find last start byte
    i = limit - 1
    while i >= 0 and (truncated[i] & 0xC0) == 0x80:
        i -= 1
    if i < 0:
        return b'', True
    lead = truncated[i]
    if lead < 0x80:
        expected = 1
    elif 0xC2 <= lead <= 0xDF:
        expected = 2
    elif 0xE0 <= lead <= 0xEF:
        expected = 3
    elif 0xF0 <= lead <= 0xF4:
        expected = 4
    else:
        expected = 1
    if i + expected > limit:
        truncated = truncated[:i]
    else:
        truncated = truncated[:i + expected]
    return truncated, True
```

    stored, truncated = _truncate_utf8(data, limit)
    buffer = bytearray(buffer_size)
    buffer[:len(stored)] = stored
    buffer[buffer_size - 1] = 0
    return bytes(buffer), truncated
